_new_keys: compaction, compactionSummaryMode, tailBehavior, compactAfterBy — v3 config surface
_renamed: v2 example → example-config-old.json (migration fixture); this file is the post-reorg surface
_comment_compaction: automatic | manual | off. 'automatic' triggers on threshold, 'manual' only on /blackhole, 'off' leaves compaction to Pi. compactionEngine was folded in (v3): 'blackhole' → 'automatic', 'pi-default' → 'off'; 'auto' is still accepted as an alias.
_comment_threshold: Auto-compaction = one shape (compactAfterBy) clamped to an optional floor/ceiling band. effective = clamp(shape(window), compactAfterMinTokens, compactAfterMaxTokens).
_comment_compactAfterPreset: Curve used when compactAfterBy = 'preset'. The built-in 'default' curve scales the trigger to the model's context window: floor(window × ratio), 0.90 @ 32,768 → 0.40 @ 1,048,576.
_comment_compactAfterRatio: Value when compactAfterBy = 'percent' — a PERCENT in (0, 100]. 0 = not set. (Was a fraction 0.46 before v3; the fraction is converted to 46 on migration.)
_comment_compactAfterTokens: Value when compactAfterBy = 'tokens' — a flat count on every model. 0 = not set. Exactly 81000 is legacy scaffold residue and is dropped.
_comment_compactReserveTokens: Value when compactAfterBy = 'reserve' — keep this much headroom free: threshold = window − reserve. 0 = not set.
_comment_compactAfterMinTokens: Floor: never compact below this many tokens, whatever the shape computes. 0 = no floor.
_comment_compactAfterMaxTokens: Ceiling: never wait past this many tokens, whatever the shape computes. 0 = no ceiling. Example: { compactAfterBy: 'percent', compactAfterRatio: 46, compactAfterMaxTokens: 180000 } → 256k @ ~120k, 1M @ 180k.
_comment_compactAfterPresets: Hand-edited preset definitions only — never a settings-modal field, and config saves carry them verbatim. Same-name entries override the built-in curve; new names extend the table and appear in the modal's preset select. 'early-1m' is an example user preset (single anchor = constant ratio).
_comment_reflectorInputMaxTokens: Largest memory snapshot an insight-building or pruning job reads (shared). dropperInputMaxTokens was merged into this key in v3.
_comment_dropperPressureThreshold: Prune memory when note memory is this fraction full. dropperPoolFullnessThreshold was merged into this key in v3 (new-data floor is the constant 0.10). 1 disables pressure-driven pruning.
_comment_cacheRetention: Optional (leave absent by default): none | short | long. Absent inherits pi's effective setting. Pinning 'short' downgrades a host whose effective setting is longer; adapters that lack 'long' ignore it. The modal's 'unset' choice removes the key.
_comment_skipForProviders: EXPERIMENTAL compatibility shim (pi-codex-compaction coexistence): providers for which blackhole steps aside entirely — no compaction, no observational-memory consolidation. Entries: bare provider or 'provider:api'. Env override PI_BLACKHOLE_SKIP_PROVIDERS (comma-separated). Default [] = disabled. Deliberately unsurfaced in README/CONFIG.md; do not rely on it.

_notes: v3 config surface:
compaction (automatic|manual|off) — how compaction triggers
compactionSummaryMode (default|append) — replace one summary or freeze auto-compaction segments
tailBehavior (pi-default|minimal) — how much stays visible
midRunCompaction (resume|pause|off) — threshold check during tool loops
compactAfterBy (preset|percent|tokens|reserve) + compactAfterMinTokens / compactAfterMaxTokens — the threshold shape and band
retainedToolOutputMaxTokens — newest-first historical tool-output text budget; older text remains available through recall
observationsPoolMaxTokens / reflectionsPoolMaxTokens — rendered-line caps including IDs and separators; headings/footer extra; source history retained
append rebase — pressure plus useful saving at existing compactions; cadence unchanged
sessionFallback (true|false) — if false, skip session model as last-resort fallback
dropperPressureThreshold (0-1, default 0.70) — fraction of the note-memory budget where pruning fires without new data (1 disables)
providerIdleTimeoutMs (ms, 0=disabled, unset=inherit pi default) — body-idle timeout for background provider streams
workerAttemptTimeoutMs (ms, 0/unset=disabled, max 2147483647) — hard elapsed deadline per worker/model attempt
cacheRetention (none|short|long, unset=inherit pi's effective setting) — prompt-cache retention for the worker streams
compactAfterPreset / compactAfterPresets — preset curve selection + definitions (default curve 0.90@32k → 0.40@1M)

Migration: v2 and older keys (overrideDefaultCompaction, noAutoCompact, passive, compactionEngine, observationsPoolTargetTokens, observerPreambleMaxTokens, dropperInputMaxTokens, dropperPoolFullnessThreshold) are rewritten on disk by a two-phase, verified migration; see docs/MIGRATION-GUIDE.md.
Env overrides:
PI_BLACKHOLE_PASSIVE=1  → compaction:off + memory:false
PI_BLACKHOLE_COMPACTION  → override compaction setting (automatic|manual|off|auto)
PI_BLACKHOLE_COMPACTION_SUMMARY_MODE → override compactionSummaryMode setting
PI_BLACKHOLE_COMPACT_AFTER_TOKENS / _RATIO / _RESERVE_TOKENS → override the value and force the matching shape
PI_BLACKHOLE_COMPACT_AFTER_PRESET → override the compaction preset curve selection
PI_BLACKHOLE_RETAINED_TOOL_OUTPUT_MAX_TOKENS → override retained tool-output budget
PI_BLACKHOLE_REFLECTIONS_POOL_MAX_TOKENS → override reflection output budget
PI_BLACKHOLE_CACHE_RETENTION → override worker prompt-cache retention (none|short|long)
